claim: In the randomized pilot, the lower price increased conversion by 2 percentage points.

sources.excerpt: The randomized pilot assigned 2,000 visitors to each price. Conversion was 10% at the original price and 12% at the lower price. No other treatment differed.

rationale: The claim is scoped to this randomized pilot and correctly states the observed absolute difference; it does not promise a future effect or statistical significance.

claim: The high price caused the conversion decline.

sources.excerpt: Three of eight self-selected interview participants mentioned price. We did not compare conversion rates or measure changes in traffic quality.

rationale: Mentioning price does not isolate the cause of a conversion decline.

sources.excerpt: The final pilot roster contains 24 distinct teams. No team appears twice.

rationale: The source explicitly supplies the claimed count.

sources.excerpt: The final pilot roster contains 24 distinct teams. No team appears twice.

rationale: The source explicitly states a different count for the same pilot.

sources.excerpt: Conversion moved from 10% to 12%, a 20% relative increase.

rationale: The absolute increase is 2 percentage points, not 20. The matching number refers to a different unit.

claim: The service will maintain 99.9% availability next year.

sources.excerpt: Measured availability during the previous calendar year was 99.9%. Future availability is not guaranteed.

rationale: A historical observation does not establish the future outcome; the source does not say that future availability will be lower either.

claim: All customers prefer the new editor.

sources.excerpt: All 12 participants in the volunteer design-partner group preferred the new editor. We did not survey other customers.

rationale: Evidence for a volunteer subgroup cannot establish a universal customer preference.

claim: All participants in the volunteer design-partner group preferred the new editor.

sources.excerpt: All 12 participants in the volunteer design-partner group preferred the new editor. We did not survey other customers.

rationale: The claim preserves the measured population and makes no broader inference.

claim: The recovery drill restored every record.

sources.excerpt: The recovery drill completed successfully. However, 17 records created during the last minute were not restored.

rationale: Quoting only the first sentence would hide the explicit exception to every record.

sources.excerpt: The May billing export lists 60 renewed customers.
The May renewal audit lists 57 renewed customers. The discrepancy with the billing export remains unresolved.

rationale: The complete source set is unresolved; one matching source cannot establish the exact count over the conflicting audit.

claim: The security review approved the release.

sources.excerpt: The security review did not approve the release. Two blocking issues remain open.

rationale: The source directly negates the approval claim.

claim: The team has not yet established whether the migration reduces costs.

sources.excerpt: Cost outcomes are still unknown. The migration experiment has not finished, so we cannot establish whether it reduces costs.

rationale: A claim accurately describing uncertainty is supported; uncertainty does not automatically make every claim insufficient.
